summaryZh: Amaro 实验室开发和应用计算与理论技术，研究复杂生物系统的结构、功能和动态，并服务于药物发现。团队采用生物物理分子动力学模拟等工具，解析分子识别、病毒结构及其与宿主细胞的相互作用。
researchQuestions: 药物及抗病毒耐药的机制是什么？

evidence.quote: The Amaro Lab is broadly concerned with the development and application of state-of-the-art computational and theoretical techniques to investigate the structure, function, and dynamics of complex biological systems.
Biophysical molecular dynamics simulations are one such technique that allow researchers to restore the structures of experimentally determined biomolecular machines back to their original state
The Amaro lab uses such tools to explore the structure and dynamics of viruses and their interactions with the host cell
Contact Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry University of California, San Diego
Our work in this area focuses primarily on three major goals: the incorporation of receptor flexibility, investigating mechanisms of drug and antiviral resistance, and disease network pharmacology.
